summary_text: In April 2026, the user purchased fresh fruit on two independent dates. Sindhura mangoes (including the SUPERPLUM variant) were bought on both 2026-04-04 and 2026-04-14, establishing a stable preference. Watermelon Kiran was purchased only on 2026-04-14. Purchases occurred in the afternoon and evening, with no single daypart dominating the small sample size.

stable_preference_claims.claim_text: The user has a stable preference for Sindhura mangoes, evidenced by purchases on 2026-04-04 and 2026-04-14.

uncertainty_text: The sample size is small (2 independent dates). While Sindhura mangoes show a stable pattern, the user's broader fruit preferences are not fully defined. Watermelon Kiran is a single-date observation and is excluded from stable claims.
